title: CLR/77/2016 of Ajay Bali Vs Gyanchand

paras.text:
CLR No. 77 of 2016
Honíble Servesh Kumar Gupta, J.
Mr. Pankaj Tangwan, Advocate for
the revisionist.
Mr. Ramji Srivastava, Advocate for
the respondent.
Learned counsel for the revisionist
has urged that he intends to vacate the
shop, in question, but some time should
be accorded for shifting his medical
practice clinic to some other place, so
that the patients may be apprised about
such shifting.
I think that six monthsí time from
today is sufficient for this purpose.
Mr. Ajay Bali (revisionist herein)
shall file supplementary affidavit along
with undertaking that he will vacate the
questioned shop on or before 30th
November, 2016.
Subject to furnishing such affidavit
and undertaking, this revision is disposed
of.
Revisionist Mr. Ajay Bali will submit
the affidavit and undertaking before the
Trial Court.
Rent and mesne profit, at the same
rate, as has been awarded by the Court
below, shall be deposited by the
revisionist-tenant to the respondent-landlord.
Stay application (CLMA No.4711 of
2016) stands disposed of.
 (Servesh Kumar Gupta, J.)
 01.06.2016
Nadim/NISHANT
